properties.name: The v0.94.0 cut takes in #815 before it ships
properties.rationale: #815 is folded as Changed rather than listed under Fixed because the fault it fixes (a local caller with no name told settling was "a question for the owner") never shipped in a release; a consumer of 0.93.1 sees only the final behaviour. Re-measured against the published 0.93.1 binary on the merged build: 199 tools, only search_design's output schema differs (toolsnap: all 199 match); 35 skills, none changed; get_instructions now differs, in step 0a only (35,921 -> 36,288 bytes); describe_schema identical; schema stamp unmoved. On --call the settle hint is set_decision_status again, as in 0.93.1, on a design naming no owner and on one OWNED_BY someone; writes_for naming a non-owner in a session gets ask_question. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P

properties.summary: The owner fixed two faults before 0.94.0 shipped (#815, merged at 5c943e7c9): the settling cue offers set_decision_status unless the caller is known and is not an owner, and get_instructions step 0a names graph_report_markdown first. release/v0.94.0 merged main in; #815's fragment is folded into CHANGELOG [0.94.0]'s Changed entries; "In your setup" is re-checked on a fresh build of the merged branch; AGENTS.md re-accepted at its merged content; #815's ChangeEvent and acceptance and this cut's new acceptance are pinned to epoch:v0940-cut.
